exactText: I remain confident that we will have the basic functionality for level five autonomy complete this year.
sourceQuote: we will have the basic functionality for level five autonomy complete this year.
normalizedClaim: Tesla completes basic functionality for Level 5 autonomy by the end of 2020.
resolutionCriteria: Tesla public statements, FSD software releases, or regulatory filings confirming Level 5 (full unsupervised autonomy in all conditions) capability by 2020-12-31.

resolution.explanation: Tesla did not achieve Level 5 autonomy in 2020; FSD remained supervised (SAE Level 2) and continues to require driver attention years later.

exactText: We're going to be launching unsupervised Full Self-Driving as a paid service in Austin in June.
